levels.descriptor: Describes a club's playing style in a few words, for example how it presses and builds up.
Breaks a playing style into principles for each phase of play and spots them in a match.
Writes a club playing-style document that coaches, analysts and recruiters can apply.
Sets one playing style from academy to first team and checks that every department follows it.
Names the main set-piece types and the roles players take in them.
Reads an opponent's set-piece routine from footage and points out its weak spot.
Designs attacking and defensive set-piece routines and coaches them in a session.
Runs the club's set-piece programme and agrees its training time with the head coach.
Reads a squad list by position, age and contract end date.
Maps the squad's gaps for the next season.
Builds a multi-year squad plan with succession for every position.
Owns squad renewal and aligns recruitment, academy and the head coach with the plan.
Explains how a scouting network is organised by region and level.
Assigns matches to scouts and tracks their coverage.
Runs a scouting network and moves its coverage to where the club needs players.
Builds the scouting, analytics and video structure that recruitment depends on.
Explains the parties in a transfer: clubs, player, agent.
Prepares a negotiation brief with fee and wage limits.
Negotiates transfers, loans or contracts inside agreed limits.
Leads the club's major negotiations and coaches staff in negotiating.
Names the parts of a player contract: length, wage, bonuses and clauses.
Compares two contract offers and their cost over time.
Designs contract structures that fit the squad plan and the budget.
Sets the club's contract policy and approves the structures used.
Explains what a club's sporting strategy covers: style, squad, academy and staff.
Writes how one department supports the sporting strategy.
Writes a multi-year sporting strategy and links it to recruitment and the academy.
Sets the club's sporting strategy and keeps it stable through changes of coach.
Explains how clubs hire coaches and specialist staff.
Writes a role profile and interview questions for one post.
Runs a hiring process and recommends a candidate with evidence.
Appoints the head coach and senior staff and plans their succession.
Draws a club's football structure and its reporting lines.
Compares two club structures and their trade-offs.
Designs a department structure with clear roles and decision rights.
Sets the club structure and who owns each decision across football and business.
Explains how owners, the board and the chief executive govern a club.
Prepares a short board update on one football topic.
Presents football plans to the board and wins support for them.
Represents football at board level and keeps owner support through difficult periods.
Explains the pathway from academy to first team.
Maps one player's next steps on the pathway.
Plans pathways for a group of players with coaches and recruitment.
Owns the club's pathway and aligns academy and first team in one style.
